verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own docs say prompts can be tested interactively in a built-in LLM Playground, and related docs describe running experiments on new prompt versions against datasets inside Langfuse. So the core playground capability exists. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and says nothing about which real model providers can be called or how prompt variables are filled in. Missing for 10: documented real-model/provider selection in the playground, prompt variable substitution in the playground, saving playground iterations back to prompt versions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables

citations.quote: Test prompts interactively in the LLM Playground
